Avoid the hit to avoid getting dance-off'd!

name: Dansu!
description:
A twirling technique that can be executed repeatedly once the \Skill[440] connects.
Deals light \element[2] damage to all nearby targets and may apply \State[5](25%).

name: Frozen Flower
description:
The nearest foe is directly impaled by a bloom of an icey flower.
May inflict \State[8](25%) and \State[10](50%).

name: Infectious Puncture
description:
A ruthless penetration that seals healing and lascerates the target.
Often applies \state[15](80%) and \state[17](80%).

name: Chilly Breath
description:
Spews forth a W(3) of chilly breath, dealing moderate \element[5] damage repeatedly.
Inflicts \State[36] to any damaged foes, and scales with proficiency.

name: Ka-peck
description: A dangerously strong peck that deals heavy damage.

name: Ka-peck-peck
description: A dangerously strong follow-up peck dealing very heavy damage.

name: Ka-peck-peck-peck
description:
A deadly strong peck that deals massive damage and knocks
the target way back applying \state[18].

name: Wings of Wrath
description:
Beats wings rapidly to generate field-blasting winds.
Scales rapidly with usage.

name: Ruthless Wing
description:
Beats wings to launch a deadly gust of air straight ahead.
May apply \State[7](33%).

name: Rending Chaos
description: Fires a W(3) of chaotic wind blades that rend anything they touch.

said battler. These states cannot stack,
which means they cannot be re-applied from
any other sources while the battler has
this skill learnt.
